rule: Replace the seven failed articles in place with independent topics. Do not retain their old argument sequence, worked example, title, slug, hash, or audit verdict.

replacements.title: Review HTTP 425 Before Early Data Replays a Product Action
replacements.decision: Which requests may be processed from TLS early data and which must wait or receive 425 at the gateway-to-origin boundary.
replacements.workedExample: A synthetic reservation command traverses a gateway twice with Early-Data: 1; the unsafe action remains unchanged and retries only after handshake completion.

replacements.title: Review Permissions Policy Before an Embedded Tool Uses Browser Features
replacements.decision: Which document origins may use a selected browser capability across response-header and iframe allow boundaries.
replacements.workedExample: A same-origin page, an approved embedded origin, and an unapproved sibling each request geolocation under a narrow policy and record the browser decision.

replacements.title: Prevent Overlapping Bookings With a PostgreSQL Exclusion Constraint
replacements.decision: Whether a database range and exclusion constraint should own the non-overlap invariant instead of an application check followed by insert.
replacements.workedExample: Two transactions reserve overlapping half-open time ranges for the same synthetic room while a separate room remains valid.

replacements.title: A Node.js Worker Transfer-Ownership Study for CPU-Bound API Work
replacements.decision: When structured cloning, transfer lists, or shared memory preserve ownership and isolation for buffers sent to a worker pool.
replacements.workedExample: Aliased TypedArray views cross clone and transfer cases; the harness checks detachment, unintended pool disclosure, mutation visibility, cancellation, and worker replacement.

replacements.title: A PostgreSQL Exclusion-Constraint Concurrency Study for Scheduling Work
replacements.decision: Whether range semantics and a GiST exclusion constraint enforce one scheduling invariant under concurrent inserts and updates.
replacements.workedExample: Barrier-synchronized transactions attempt adjacent, overlapping, empty, unbounded, and cross-resource reservations, with lock and error evidence retained.

replacements.title: A Kubernetes StatefulSet Partitioned-Rollout Study for Ordered Services
replacements.decision: How a rollingUpdate partition, ordinal identity, readiness, and rollback interact during a staged StatefulSet change.
replacements.workedExample: A three-replica synthetic StatefulSet updates the highest ordinal first, pauses at a partition, injects a readiness failure, then verifies revision and storage identity during recovery.

replacements.title: A Next.js after() Lifecycle Study for Post-Response Work
replacements.decision: Which post-response tasks can use after(), how self-hosted waitUntil support affects completion, and which durable effects still require a queue.
replacements.workedExample: A route schedules synthetic audit work across success, thrown error, redirect, timeout, process termination, static generation, and duplicate request cases.
